title: SparkleDex
description: A secure, mobile-first full-stack web app to track a mobile game collection and share it with friends through a read-only public link. Built solo with a team workflow: one branch and PR per topic, a CI pipeline on every pull request (lint, type checks, tests, dependency audit, secret scanning) that must pass before merging into a protected main branch, Conventional Commits and automated semantic releases. Security by design: PostgreSQL Row Level Security covered by tests, server-side validation, CSRF protection, httpOnly session cookies, supply-chain checks (gitleaks, Dependabot, SHA-pinned actions) and GDPR-minded data handling. Underway: Docker, continuous delivery to Kubernetes and further hardening.
